l4_steps.name: Pull aircraft DOW/DOI from maintenance system
l4_steps.output: Dry Operating Weight, Dry Operating Index, seating config, hold bay limits
l4_steps.kpi: Configuration accuracy 100%; zero dispatches with incorrect DOW
l4_steps.pain_point: Last-minute aircraft swaps (e.g., 737-800 replaced by 737-700) cause DOW discrepancy if AMOS weight record not updated within 30 min of tail reassignment

l4_steps.name: Retrieve fuel uplift from flight planning system
l4_steps.input: Signed flight plan released by dispatcher
l4_steps.output: Fuel figure (trip, contingency, alternate, final reserve) in kg for load calculation
l4_steps.kpi: Fuel data transfer latency < 5 min from dispatch plan release
l4_steps.pain_point: Manual re-entry required when API link between Lido/Flight and SITA LoadManager is unavailable; transcription errors produce erroneous TOW calculations

l4_steps.name: Calculate structural limits and underload allowance
l4_steps.input: DOW, fuel load, aircraft type structural limits (MTOW, MZFW, MLW, MAC envelope)
l4_steps.output: Maximum payload, underload figure, allowed traffic load by cabin and hold
l4_steps.kpi: Underload figure accuracy ±50 kg versus final actuals
l4_steps.pain_point: MZFW and MTOW vary by 737 sub-variant (e.g., 737-800 vs 737-8 MAX); incorrect variant code in LoadManager causes structural limit overrun risk without automated alert

l4_steps.name: Extract PAX counts from check-in at cutoff
l4_steps.input: Departure control check-in data at standard cutoff (T-35 min)
l4_steps.output: Final passenger counts by cabin class; PAX weight totals using standard weights
l4_steps.pain_point: Late check-in waivers granted after cutoff add PAX to Altéa without auto-alerting load controller; controller may issue load sheet based on stale PAX count

l4_steps.name: Apply IATA standard or actual PAX weights
l4_steps.input: PAX count, season flag, route type (domestic/international), cabin class mix
l4_steps.output: Total PAX weight per IATA Resolution 788 (84 kg male / 76 kg female with carry-on)
l4_steps.kpi: Weight deviation vs actuals < 2% for domestic routes
l4_steps.pain_point: Incorrect season flag (summer/winter) in SITA LoadManager causes systematic 4 kg/PAX under-estimate on narrow-body routes with no automated audit trail for season changes

l4_steps.name: Capture checked baggage weights at bag room
l4_steps.input: Baggage tag scans at make-up area belt
l4_steps.output: Per-flight total hold baggage weight by zone and ULD
l4_steps.kpi: Baggage weight reconciliation ≥ 99% of tagged bags per flight
l4_steps.pain_point: Individual baggage weighting not performed on narrow-body short-haul; weight estimated from PAX count × standard bag weight, resulting in actual vs plan variance exceeding 200 kg on full flights

l4_steps.name: Process special PAX categories from SSR codes
l4_steps.input: SSR codes (UMNR, WCHC, EXST, BSCT, MEDA) from reservation record
l4_steps.output: Special category weights and seating constraints applied to load plan
l4_steps.kpi: SSR compliance rate 100%; zero unmanaged special PAX categories at load sheet issue
l4_steps.pain_point: EXST (extra seat) PAX body weight not consistently captured in Altéa SSR; load controller must query gate agent manually, adding 5–10 min and creating CG error risk

l4_steps.name: Receive cargo manifest and ULD build data
l4_steps.input: Air waybill manifest, ULD build sheets from cargo acceptance
l4_steps.output: Cargo weight, volume, and loading sequence by hold bay
l4_steps.kpi: Cargo manifest received ≥ T-60 min before departure; late manifest rate < 5%
l4_steps.pain_point: Belly cargo manifest routinely received < T-30 min for connection flights; load controller must estimate cargo weight, creating CG shift risk if actuals differ by more than 150 kg

l4_steps.name: Validate and approve DG load — issue NOTOC
l4_steps.input: DG declaration, ICAO packing group, quantity and UN number
l4_steps.output: Approved DG stowage position; NOTOC transmitted to captain via ACARS
l4_steps.kpi: DG NOTOC issued to captain ≥ T-30 min before departure; 100% ICAO Annex 18 compliance
l4_steps.pain_point: Late DG declarations from freight forwarders cause NOTOC amendments after load sheet issue; each amendment requires captain re-signature, adding 10–20 min average delay

l4_steps.name: Allocate hold bay loading positions for CG target
l4_steps.input: Cargo weight and volume by ULD, DG stowage rules, ZFW CG target
l4_steps.output: Bay loading plan (fwd/aft hold, bulk), tie-down instructions for ramp crew
l4_steps.kpi: CG within ±1% MAC of target after initial bay allocation
l4_steps.pain_point: Manual bay allocation for 737 holds (bays 41F/42G/43H) is error-prone; no automated CG feedback loop in LoadManager until all weights are confirmed, delaying detection of CG exceedance

l4_steps.name: Generate preliminary e-LoadSheet with ZFW/TOW/LDW
l4_steps.input: PAX weights, baggage weights, cargo bay plan, fuel load, DOW
l4_steps.output: Preliminary ZFW, TOW, LDW, CG %MAC on electronic Load Sheet
l4_steps.kpi: Preliminary load sheet ready ≥ T-30 min before scheduled departure
l4_steps.pain_point: Tankering fuel decisions made by dispatch after preliminary load sheet generation require full recalculation; re-issue cycle adds 5 min and risks version mismatch between load controller and captain

l4_steps.name: Validate CG within certified flight envelope
l4_steps.input: TOW and CG %MAC from preliminary load sheet
l4_steps.output: CG validation result — pass or fail against fwd and aft certified limits
l4_steps.kpi: CG out-of-envelope rate < 0.01% of departures (IATA industry benchmark)
l4_steps.pain_point: Aft CG limit exceedance on 737-800 with full cabin and light belly cargo is a known risk scenario; redistribution or trim ballast adds 15–25 min to turnaround time

l4_steps.name: Calculate stabiliser trim setting and confirm CG index
l4_steps.input: Final TOW, CG %MAC, selected flap setting
l4_steps.output: Stab trim setting transmitted to captain; load sheet CG index confirmed
l4_steps.kpi: Stab trim setting issued to flight deck ≥ T-20 min before departure
l4_steps.pain_point: Discrepancy between load controller stab trim (SITA) and EFB-computed value (Jeppesen FliteDeck) when aircraft config tables are not synchronised; manual cross-check adds 3–5 min per occurrence

l4_steps.name: Transmit final load sheet to flight deck via ACARS
l4_steps.output: Load sheet delivered to flight deck; ACARS receipt confirmation captured
l4_steps.kpi: Load sheet delivery ≥ T-20 min before departure; ACARS receipt confirmation within 2 min
l4_steps.pain_point: ACARS transmission failure at remote stands without ground-to-aircraft data link requires manual paper load sheet handoff, breaking the e-signature audit trail required under ICAO Annex 6

l4_steps.name: Captain reviews and signs load sheet on EFB
l4_steps.input: e-LoadSheet, stab trim, NOTOC, and fuel plan
l4_steps.output: Captain's electronic signature on load sheet; acceptance transmitted to load control
l4_steps.kpi: Captain acceptance cycle time < 5 min; load sheet rejection rate < 0.5%
l4_steps.pain_point: Captain queries on ZFW discrepancy require callback to load controller; FliteDeck has no in-app messaging, forcing VHF or phone communication and adding average 4 min delay per query

l4_steps.name: Issue final loading instruction and close holds
l4_steps.input: Accepted load sheet, finalised bay loading plan
l4_steps.output: Final loading instruction transmitted to ramp; hold door closure authorised
l4_steps.kpi: Hold closure notification ≥ T-10 min before departure; D0 on-time departure impact attributable to W&B < 0.3%
l4_steps.pain_point: Late passenger offloads (IROPS, no-show reconciliation) after hold closure require baggage pull, repeat CG validation, and captain re-acceptance — average additional delay 20 min per occurrence

l4_steps.name: Archive load sheet and transmit LDM to destination
l4_steps.input: Signed load sheet; final PAX, cargo, and fuel actuals
l4_steps.output: Load Distribution Message (LDM) transmitted to destination station and OCC; load sheet archived per ICAO Annex 6 (24-month retention)
l4_steps.kpi: LDM transmitted within 5 min of actual departure; 100% archival compliance rate
l4_steps.pain_point: LDM is not auto-transmitted when SITA LoadManager is in failover mode; manual Telex composition is error-prone and causes destination station misinterpretation of hold contents
